definitions.explanation: The formal act of presenting a gift, award, or certificate to someone. More formal than simply giving.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花束|はなたば}→花束：03135_hanataba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{贈呈|ぞうてい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To present a bouquet of flowers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{記念品|きねんひん}→記念品：03049_kinenhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{贈呈|ぞうてい}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Commemorative gifts were presented at the graduation ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{功績|こうせき}→功績：04143_kouseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧たたえて{感謝状|かんしゃじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{贈呈|ぞうてい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A certificate of appreciation was presented in recognition of many years of meritorious service.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word used primarily in ceremonial or official contexts. Common at award ceremonies, graduations, and official events. Used as a suru verb ({贈呈|ぞうてい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{花束|はなたば}→花束：03135_hanataba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{贈呈|ぞうてい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to present a bouquet)
- ⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{贈呈|ぞうてい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to present an award)
- ⟦{記念品|きねんひん}→記念品：03049_kinenhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{贈呈|ぞうてい} (presentation of a commemorative item)
- {贈呈|ぞうてい}{式|しき} (presentation ceremony)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{進呈|しんてい}→進呈：18249_shintei⟧: presenting, offering — also formal, often used for complimentary items
- ⟦{授与|じゅよ}→授与：12900_juyo⟧: conferral — used for degrees and official awards
